011import static org.clafer.ir.IrCompare.Op.NotEqual;
012import org.clafer.ir.IrIfOnlyIf;
013import org.clafer.ir.IrIfThenElse;
014import org.clafer.ir.IrIntExpr;
015import org.clafer.ir.IrLone;
016import org.clafer.ir.IrModule;
017import org.clafer.ir.IrNot;
018import org.clafer.ir.IrOffset;
019import org.clafer.ir.IrOr;

021import org.clafer.ir.IrSetExpr;

024import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.and;
025import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.equal;
026import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.greaterThan;
027import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.greaterThanEqual;
028import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.ifOnlyIf;
029import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.ifThenElse;
030import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.lessThanEqual;

032import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.mul;
033import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.not;
034import static org.clafer.ir.Irs.offset;

039/**
040 *
041 * @author jimmy
042 */
043public class Optimizer {
044
045    private Optimizer() {
046    }
047
048    /**
049     * Optimize the module.
050     *
051     * @param module the module to optimize
052     * @return the optimized module
053     */
054    public static IrModule optimize(IrModule module) {
055        return optimizer.rewrite(module, null);
056    }
057
058    private static Stream<Compare> compares(IrIntExpr expr) {
059        if (expr instanceof IrCompare) {
060            IrCompare compare = (IrCompare) expr;
061            switch (compare.getOp()) {
062                case Equal:
063                case NotEqual:
064                    return Stream.of(
065                            new Compare(compare.getLeft(), compare.getOp(), compare.getRight()),
066                            new Compare(compare.getRight(), compare.getOp(), compare.getLeft()));
067                default:
068                    return Stream.of(
069                            new Compare(compare.getLeft(), compare.getOp(), compare.getRight()));
070            }
071        } else if (expr instanceof IrOr) {
072            IrOr or = (IrOr) expr;
073            if (or.getOperands().length == 2) {
074                IrBoolExpr left = or.getOperands()[0];
075                IrBoolExpr right = or.getOperands()[1];
076                return Stream.of(
077                        new Compare(not(left), IrCompare.Op.LessThanEqual, right),
078                        new Compare(not(right), IrCompare.Op.LessThanEqual, left)
079                );
080            }
081        } else if (expr instanceof IrIfOnlyIf) {
082            IrIfOnlyIf ifOnlyIf = (IrIfOnlyIf) expr;
083            return Stream.of(
084                    new Compare(ifOnlyIf.getLeft(), IrCompare.Op.Equal, ifOnlyIf.getRight()),
085                    new Compare(ifOnlyIf.getRight(), IrCompare.Op.Equal, ifOnlyIf.getLeft()));
086        }
087        return Stream.empty();
088    }
089
090    private static Stream<Compare> moreCompares(IrIntExpr expr) {
091        if (expr instanceof IrNot) {
092            IrNot not = (IrNot) expr;
093            return Stream.of(
094                    new Compare(not.getExpr(), IrCompare.Op.Equal, Irs.Zero),
095                    new Compare(Irs.Zero, IrCompare.Op.Equal, not.getExpr()));
096        }
097        return compares(expr);
098    }
099
100    private static final IrRewriter<Void> optimizer = new IrRewriter<Void>() {
101        @Override
102        public IrBoolExpr visit(IrLone ir, Void a) {
103            IrBoolExpr[] operands = rewrite(ir.getOperands(), a);
104            if (operands.length == 2) {
105                Optional<IrBoolExpr> opt
106                        = Stream.concat(
107                                compares(operands[0]).map(r -> optimizeLoneCompare(operands[1], r)),
108                                compares(operands[1]).map(r -> optimizeLoneCompare(operands[0], r)))
109                        .filter(Objects::nonNull)
110                        .findFirst();
111                if (opt.isPresent()) {
112                    return opt.get();
113                }
114            }
115            return changed(ir.getOperands(), operands)
116                    ? lone(operands)
117                    : ir;
118        }
119
120        @Override
121        public IrBoolExpr visit(IrOr ir, Void a) {
122            IrBoolExpr[] operands = rewrite(ir.getOperands(), a);
123            if (operands.length == 2) {
124                Optional<IrBoolExpr> opt
125                        = Stream.concat(
126                                compares(operands[0]).map(r -> optimizeOrCompare(operands[1], r)),
127                                compares(operands[1]).map(r -> optimizeOrCompare(operands[0], r)))
128                        .filter(Objects::nonNull)
129                        .findFirst();
130                if (opt.isPresent()) {
131                    return opt.get();
132                }
133            }
134            return changed(ir.getOperands(), operands)
135                    ? or(operands)
136                    : ir;
137        }
138
139        @Override
140        public IrBoolExpr visit(IrIfThenElse ir, Void a) {
141            IrBoolExpr antecedent = rewrite(ir.getAntecedent(), a);
142            IrBoolExpr consequent = rewrite(ir.getConsequent(), a);
143            IrBoolExpr alternative = rewrite(ir.getAlternative(), a);
144            Optional<IrBoolExpr> opt
145                    = moreCompares(consequent).flatMap(l
146                            -> moreCompares(alternative).map(r
147                                    -> optimizeIfThenElseCompare(antecedent, l, r)))
148                    .filter(Objects::nonNull)
149                    .findFirst();
150            if (opt.isPresent()) {
151                return opt.get();
152            }
153            return changed(ir.getAntecedent(), antecedent)
154                    || changed(ir.getConsequent(), consequent)
155                    || changed(ir.getAlternative(), alternative)
156                            ? ifThenElse(antecedent, consequent, alternative)
157                            : ir;
158        }
159
160        @Override
161        public IrBoolExpr visit(IrIfOnlyIf ir, Void a) {
162            IrBoolExpr left = rewrite(ir.getLeft(), a);
163            IrBoolExpr right = rewrite(ir.getRight(), a);
164            Optional<IrBoolExpr> opt
165                    = Stream.concat(
166                            compares(right).map(r -> optimizeIfOnlyIfCompare(left, r)),
167                            compares(left).map(r -> optimizeIfOnlyIfCompare(right, r)))
168                    .filter(Objects::nonNull)
169                    .findFirst();
170            if (opt.isPresent()) {
171                return opt.get();
172            }
173            return changed(ir.getLeft(), left) || changed(ir.getRight(), right)
174                    ? ifOnlyIf(left, right)
175                    : ir;
176        }
177
178        @Override
179        public IrSetExpr visit(IrOffset ir, Void a) {
180            if (ir.getSet() instanceof IrOffset) {
181                // Rewrite
182                //    offset(offset(set, a), b)
183                // to
184                //    offset(set, a + b)
185                // This optimization is important for going multiple steps up the
186                // hierarchy.
187                IrOffset innerOffset = (IrOffset) ir.getSet();
188                return rewrite(offset(innerOffset.getSet(),
189                        ir.getOffset() + innerOffset.getOffset()), a);
190            }
191            return super.visit(ir, a);
192        }
193    };
194
195    /**
196     * Optimize {@code lone(antecedent, left `op` right)} where `op` is = or !=.
197     */
198    private static IrBoolExpr optimizeLoneCompare(IrBoolExpr antecedent, Compare compare) {
199        IrIntExpr left = compare.left;
200        IrCompare.Op op = compare.op;
201        IrIntExpr right = compare.right;
202        Domain domain = left.getDomain();
203        if (domain.size() == 2 && right.isConstant()) {
204            int constant = right.getLowBound();
205            switch (op) {
206                case Equal:
207                    // Rewrite
208                    //     lone(bool, int = 888)
209                    //         where dom(int) = {-3, 888}
210                    // to
211                    //     asInt(bool) <= 888 - int
212                    //     asInt(bool) + int <= 888
213                    if (domain.getHighBound() == constant) {
214                        return lessThanEqual(add(antecedent, left),
215                                domain.getHighBound());
216                    }
217                    // Rewrite
218                    //     lone(bool, int = -3)
219                    //         where dom(int) = {-3, 888}
220                    // to
221                    //     asInt(bool) <= int - (-3)
222                    if (domain.getLowBound() == constant) {
223                        return lessThanEqual(antecedent,
224                                sub(left, domain.getLowBound()));
225                    }
226                    break;
227                case NotEqual:
228                    // Rewrite
229                    //     lone(bool, int != 888)
230                    //         where dom(int) = {-3, 888}
231                    // to
232                    //     asInt(bool) <= int - (-3)
233                    if (domain.getHighBound() == constant) {
234                        return lessThanEqual(antecedent,
235                                sub(left, domain.getLowBound()));
236                    }
237                    // Rewrite
238                    //     lone(bool, int != -3)
239                    //         where dom(int) = {-3, 888}
240                    // to
241                    //     asInt(bool) <= 888 - int
242                    //     asInt(bool) + int <= 888
243                    if (domain.getLowBound() == constant) {
244                        return lessThanEqual(add(antecedent, left),
245                                domain.getHighBound());
246                    }
247                    break;
248            }
249        }
250        return null;
251    }
252
253    /**
254     * Optimize {@code antecedent or (left `op` right)} where `op` is = or !=.
255     */
256    private static IrBoolExpr optimizeOrCompare(IrBoolExpr antecedent, Compare compare) {
257        IrIntExpr left = compare.left;
258        IrCompare.Op op = compare.op;
259        IrIntExpr right = compare.right;
260        Domain domain = left.getDomain();
261        if (right.isConstant()) {
262            int constant = right.getLowBound();
263            if (constant == domain.getHighBound()) {
264                int span = constant - domain.getLowBound();
265                switch (op) {
266                    case Equal:
267                        if (domain.size() == 2) {
268                            // Optimize antecedent || (left == max) to
269                            // antecedent + left > min
270                            return greaterThan(add(antecedent, left), domain.getLowBound());
271                        }
272                        // Optimize antecedent || (left == max) to
273                        // left >= max - span * antecedent
274                        return greaterThanEqual(left, sub(constant, mul(span, antecedent, boundDomain(0, span))));
275                    case NotEqual:
276                        if (domain.size() == 2) {
277                            // Optimize antecedent || (left != max) to
278                            // antecedent > left - max
279                            return greaterThan(antecedent, sub(left, constant));
280                        }
281                        // Optimize antecedent || (left != max) to
282                        // left <= max - !antecedent
283                        return lessThanEqual(left, sub(constant, not(antecedent)));
284                }
285            } else if (constant == left.getLowBound()) {
286                int span = left.getHighBound() - constant;
287                switch (op) {
288                    case Equal:
289                        if (domain.size() == 2) {
290                            // Optimize antecedent || (left == min) to
291                            // antecedent > left - max
292                            return greaterThan(antecedent, sub(left, domain.getHighBound()));
293                        }
294                        // Optimize antecedent || (left == min) to
295                        // left <= min + span * antecedent
296                        return lessThanEqual(left, add(constant, mul(span, antecedent, boundDomain(0, span))));
297                    case NotEqual:
298                        if (domain.size() == 2) {
299                            // Optimize antecedent || (left != min) to
300                            // antecedent + left > min
301                            return greaterThan(add(antecedent, left), constant);
302                        }
303                        // Optimize antecedent || (left != min) to
304                        // left >= min + !antecedent
305                        return greaterThanEqual(left, add(constant, not(antecedent)));
306                }
307            }
308        }
309        return null;
310    }
311
312    /**
313     * Optimize {@code if b then x = y else x = z} to {@code x = b ? y : z}.
314     */
315    private static IrBoolExpr optimizeIfThenElseCompare(
316            IrBoolExpr condition, Compare compare1, Compare compare2) {
317        IrIntExpr left1 = compare1.left;
318        IrCompare.Op op1 = compare1.op;
319        IrIntExpr right1 = compare1.right;
320        IrIntExpr left2 = compare2.left;
321        IrCompare.Op op2 = compare2.op;
322        IrIntExpr right2 = compare2.right;
323        if (IrCompare.Op.Equal.equals(op1) && IrCompare.Op.Equal.equals(op2) && left1.equals(left2)) {
324            return equal(left1, ternary(condition, right1, right2));
325        }
326        return null;
327    }
328
329    private static IrBoolExpr optimizeIfOnlyIfCompare(IrBoolExpr reify, Compare compare) {
330        IrIntExpr left = compare.left;
331        IrCompare.Op op = compare.op;
332        IrIntExpr right = compare.right;
333        if (right.isConstant()) {
334            int constant = right.getLowBound();
335            if (constant == left.getHighBound()) {
336                int span = constant - left.getLowBound();
337                switch (op) {
338                    case Equal:
339                        if (left.getDomain().size() == 2) {
340                            // Optimize reify <=> (left == max) to
341                            // left = min + span * reify.
342                            return equal(left, add(left.getLowBound(), mul(span, reify, boundDomain(0, span))));
343                        }
344                        // Optimize reify <=> (left == max) to
345                        // (left <= max - !reify) && (left >= max - span * !reify).
346                        return and(
347                                lessThanEqual(left, sub(constant, not(reify))),
348                                greaterThanEqual(left, sub(constant, mul(span, not(reify), boundDomain(0, span)))));
349                    case NotEqual:
350                        if (left.getDomain().size() == 2) {
351                            // Optimize reify <=> (left != max) to
352                            // left = max - span * reify.
353                            return equal(left, sub(constant, mul(span, reify, boundDomain(0, span))));
354                        }
355                        // Optimize reify <=> (left != max) to
356                        // (left <= max - reify) && (left >= max - span * reify).
357                        return and(
358                                lessThanEqual(left, sub(constant, reify)),
359                                greaterThanEqual(left, sub(constant, mul(span, reify, boundDomain(0, span)))));
360                }
361            } else if (constant == left.getLowBound()) {
362                int span = left.getHighBound() - constant;
363                switch (op) {
364                    case Equal:
365                        if (left.getDomain().size() == 2) {
366                            // Optimize reify <=> (left == min) to
367                            // left = max - span * reify.
368                            return equal(left, sub(left.getHighBound(), mul(span, reify, boundDomain(0, span))));
369                        }
370                        // Optimize reify <=> (left == min) to
371                        // (left >= min + !reify) && (left <= min + span * !reify).
372                        return and(greaterThanEqual(left, add(constant, not(reify))),
373                                lessThanEqual(left, add(constant, mul(span, not(reify), boundDomain(0, span)))));
374                    case NotEqual:
375                        if (left.getDomain().size() == 2) {
376                            // Optimize reify <=> (left != min) to
377                            // left = min + span * reify.
378                            return equal(left, add(constant, mul(span, reify, boundDomain(0, span))));
379                        }
380                        // Optimize reify <=> (left != min) to
381                        // (left >= min + reify) && (left <= min + span * reify).
382                        return and(greaterThanEqual(left, add(constant, reify)),
383                                lessThanEqual(left, add(constant, mul(span, reify, boundDomain(0, span)))));
384                }
385            }
386        }
387        return null;
388    }
389
390    private static class Compare {
391
392        final IrIntExpr left;
393        final IrCompare.Op op;
394        final IrIntExpr right;
395
396        public Compare(IrIntExpr left, IrCompare.Op op, IrIntExpr right) {
397            this.left = left;
398            this.op = op;
399            this.right = right;
400        }
401
402        @Override
403        public String toString() {
404            return left + " " + op.getSyntax() + " " + right;
405        }
406    }
407}
